creator: Alexander Terp
description: Alex's chat notes, 2026-09-04 ("ssh view support") and 2026-10-13 ("some sort of ssh support ie board lives remote but local kan serve sees it"). A board in a repo on another machine (the devenv, the Mac mini) can only be viewed by running kan serve there and tunneling the port. Wanted: a local kan serve that opens a board over SSH, reading (and ideally writing) the remote .kan/. Today kan serve takes only --port and --no-open.
title: Serve a board that lives on a remote host over SSH
